entries.title: Psalms 50:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm. Of Asaph.>> *God, Elohim-Jehovah, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

entries.title: Psalms 50:2
segments: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.

entries.title: Psalms 50:3
segments: Our God will come, and will not keep silence: fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

entries.title: Psalms 50:4
segments: He will call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people:

entries.title: Psalms 50:5
segments: Gather unto me my godly ones, those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice!

entries.title: Psalms 50:6
segments: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness; for God executeth judgment himself. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 50:7
segments: ¶Hear, my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify unto thee: I am God, thy God.

entries.title: Psalms 50:8
segments: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices, or thy burnt-offerings, continually before me;

entries.title: Psalms 50:9
segments: I will take no bullock out of thy house, [nor] he-goats out of thy folds:

entries.title: Psalms 50:10
segments: For every beast of the forest is mine, the cattle upon a thousand hills;

entries.title: Psalms 50:11
segments: I know all the fowl of the mountains, and the roaming creatures of the field are mine:

entries.title: Psalms 50:12
segments: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

entries.title: Psalms 50:13
segments: Should I eat the flesh of bulls, and drink the blood of goats?

entries.title: Psalms 50:14
segments: Offer unto God thanksgiving, and perform thy vows unto the Most High;

entries.title: Psalms 50:15
segments: And call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

entries.title: Psalms 50:16
segments: ¶But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant into thy mouth,

entries.title: Psalms 50:17
segments: Seeing thou hast hated correction and hast cast my words behind thee?

entries.title: Psalms 50:18
segments: When thou sawest a thief, thou didst take pleasure in him, and thy portion was with adulterers;

entries.title: Psalms 50:19
segments: Thou lettest thy mouth loose to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit;

entries.title: Psalms 50:20
segments: Thou sittest [and] speakest against thy brother, thou revilest thine own mother's son:

entries.title: Psalms 50:21
segments: These [things] hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether as thyself: [but] I will reprove thee, and set [them] in order before thine eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 50:22
segments: Now consider this, ye that forget +God, lest I tear in pieces, and there be no deliverer.

entries.title: Psalms 50:23
segments: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me; and to him that ordereth [his] way will I shew the salvation of God.
